# vectorlite: vector search inside SQLite

vectorlite is an open-source extension that adds vector similarity search to SQLite. Embeddings are stored in a virtual table and queried with cosine or dot-product distance.

## Details

It runs in-process, needs no server and is MIT licensed. The benchmark page reports sub-10 ms queries for one million vectors on a laptop.
